name: TLL OS Architecture Truth
description: Canonical architecture truth for TLL OS. This file is machine-readable and defines the official architecture. It is NOT documentation for humans — it is engineering truth for Agents, CI, and tools.

project.name: TLL OS
project.tagline: High Frame Rate Programming Language + AI Native Engineering Foundation
project.first_principle: TLL is a high frame rate programming language. TLL OS is the operating-system-level ecosystem that runs this language and amplifies its value. AI Engineering Layer is the wing that enhances TLL, not the soul that replaces it.

architecture_layers.description: The runtime that executes TLL bytecode.
The layer that makes TLL AI-native. Enhances TLL, does not replace it.
architecture_layers.note: This layer is in bootstrap phase (P0-16.0). It provides structure and schema, but full automation is future work.

key_principles.principle: First Principle: TLL is a high frame rate programming language
key_principles.description: Everything else serves this. AI Engineering Layer is an enhancement, not a replacement.
README is for humans. .tll-engine/ is for Agents, CI, and tools. Truth must be machine-readable, versioned, and evidence-backed.

key_principles.principle: Agent can change, Truth cannot be casually changed
key_principles.description: Models, Agents, and frameworks can be swapped. Truth, Protocol, Identity, Authority, Evidence, Verification, and World Model must remain consistent.
An Agent's self-report of completion is not evidence. Completion requires CI pass + independent audit + Truth update.
